description: Timed Hardcore turns hardcore multiplayer into something you can actually play with friends. When you die, you are not gone for good. You are locked out of the server for a configurable time or until the next fixed revival time of the day.

mods.name: Timed Hardcore
mods.description: Hardcore multiplayer where death is temporary: die and you are locked out for a set time instead of forever.

releases.notes:
## Discord notifications

Timed Hardcore can now post every timed death and every revival to a Discord channel through a webhook.

- **Death**: the player's name and head, the cause of death, how long they stay dead and when they come back, with a full-body picture of the player in **black and white**.
- **Revival**: who is back, who revived them, how long they were dead and what killed them, with the picture in **colour**.
- The time of revival is a Discord timestamp: everyone sees it in their own time zone, with a live countdown.
- Pictures include the player's cape and come from [NMSR](https://nmsr.nickac.dev/) by default. Any other render service can be configured.
- Mentions are disabled, so a mob named `@everyone` pings nobody.
- Messages are sent in the background, the server never waits for Discord. Failed messages are retried up to three times.

### Setup

1. In Discord: *Server Settings → Integrations → Webhooks → New Webhook → Copy Webhook URL*
2. Paste it into `config/timed-hardcore.json`:
   ```json
   "discordWebhookUrl": "https://discord.com/api/webhooks/..."
